title: fix(spec, types): retired-key, aggregation and comparand refusals answer a one-line message on the data doors, with the prescription as hint
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFU825A5hPJokad4L8zryXh)_

Fixes #32279

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added

_Declaration moved from the order's `none` on server seat 2's ruling (2026-11-10): `FieldErrorSchema.hint` is a new authorable key (`api/FieldError:hint` in `authorable-surface`), so `Check Changeset` reads it as `added`; `@objectstack/spec` is graded `minor`, `@objectstack/types` stays `patch`._

## 维护者速读

1. 问题：数据接口拒绝请求时，把 spec 写给作者的整段说明（300 到 1300 字）原样塞进报错信息，前端提示框和 SDK 用户根本读不完。
2. 改动：每条长拒绝在 spec 源头配一句手写的短标题（≤160 字，点明被拒的键或写法以及怎么改），数据接口把短标题放进 `message`，整段说明放进新增的 `hint`。
3. 范围：所有经 `zodIssuesToFields` 返回 `fields[]` 的接口，以及 `?filter=`；涉及查询接口的已退役键（`joins` / `cursor` / `distinct`）、已退役聚合（`array_agg` / `string_agg` / `aggregations[].distinct`），以及 `where` / `?filter=` 的比较值写法错误。
4. 不变：状态码、错误码、哪些请求被拒都不变；`os compile`、元数据保存校验、`os migrate` 打印给作者的说明逐字不变（个人视图保存走 `fields[]`，同样改为短标题加 `hint`）。
5. 契约：`FieldErrorSchema` 新增可选 `hint`（放宽），`GET ?filter=` 用 `details.hint`，无新错误码；新增可选键按协议记为 `added`，spec 次版本、types 补丁版本。
6. 影响：控制台提示和 AI 客户端读到一句话的原因，需要完整规则时读 `hint`；没有标题的拒绝照旧。

## What changes

The data doors answered these refusals with the spec's whole author-facing prescription as the message (#32169 item 2b, measured on a live showcase): `array_agg` 1,021 characters, `string_agg` 1,249, `aggregations[].distinct` 1,078, retired `joins` / `cursor` / `distinct` 763 / 623 / 644, `where` comparands 314–391, `GET ?filter=` `INVALID_FILTER` 348–433. Each now also carries a **head**: one line, at most 160 characters (the PR #32303 bound), written by hand, naming the refused key or shape and the fix.

| Door | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query`, `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` | `fields[].message` = the prescription | `fields[].message` = the head, `fields[].hint` = the prescription, byte for byte |
| `GET /api/v1/data/:object?filter=`, `400 INVALID_FILTER` | `error` = `find('…'): ` + the prescription | `error` = the head (led by `find('…'):` when both fit in 160), `details.hint` = what `error` used to be |
| Every other door that answers `fields[]` through `zodIssuesToFields`: the batch and bulk routes, the record-page route, the analytics selection door (its top-level `message` is composed from `fields[].message`), the runtime dispatcher's data and analytics domains, the dataset tools, and the `sys_personal_view` save hook in `plugin-auth` | `fields[].message` = the prescription | same as `POST /query`: `fields[].message` = the head, `fields[].hint` = the prescription |
| `os compile`, `os migrate`, the metadata save doors (`zodIssuesToMetadataIssues`) | the prescription | unchanged, byte for byte |

**Split at the source, never in rest.** Nothing is cut from a prescription. Each head is written beside the text it summarises:

- `packages/spec/src/data/query.zod.ts`: `ARRAY_AGG_RETIRED`, `STRING_AGG_RETIRED`, `AGGREGATION_DISTINCT_REMOVED`, `QUERY_JOINS_REMOVED`, `QUERY_CURSOR_REMOVED`, `QUERY_DISTINCT_REMOVED` are wrapped in `withRefusalHead(prescription, head)`, which returns the prescription unchanged and registers the head against it.
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter-comparand-shape.ts`: each of the face's ten `INVALID_FILTER` arms writes its head; the thrown error keeps its message and carries `refusalHead`.
- `packages/spec/src/data/filter-save-door-refusals.ts`: the save door's issue takes the face's head (the verdict is the face's, and the head names operator, field and fix, never the location), and its non-boolean flag arm writes its own; the head rides as `params.refusalHead` on the `custom` issue.

**One reader, two mappers.** `packages/spec/src/shared/refusal-head.ts` holds `REFUSAL_HEAD_MAX`, the head contract and `refusalHeadOf`, which reads the three carriers (an error's `refusalHead`, an issue's `params.refusalHead`, the head registered for a constant prescription). Zod lets an error-map refusal (a `z.never` tombstone, a retired enum member) carry nothing but its message, which is why the constants register; the registry lives on `globalThis` under `Symbol.for(…)` so an ESM and a CJS copy of spec in one host share it, and it only ever holds the six module constants (a per-request text carries its head on the error or the issue instead).

- `zodIssuesToFields` (`packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts`), the one ADR-0114 D3 mapper every `fields[]` door calls (rest `crud-routes`, the runtime dispatcher through `@objectstack/types` `fieldsFromZodIssues`), answers `{ message: head, hint: prescription }` when the issue has a head, and exactly what it answered before otherwise.
- `@objectstack/types` `withDeclaredUserMessage`, the wrapper every exit that renders a thrown error's sentence passes through (rest's declared-status passthrough and every arm of `mapDataError`), swaps a 4xx refusal's `error` for its head and moves the old text to `details.hint` (merged, so `details.candidates` survives). 5xx, a non-string `error`, and every error without a head are returned as they were.
- `FieldErrorSchema` gains `hint: z.string().optional()`. It is a non-strict `z.object`, and `validationFailure` passes `fields` through as `unknown[]`, so no strictness changes. `ApiErrorSchema.details` is `unknown`, so `details.hint` needs no schema change.

**Measured deviation from the order's file surface (seat's assumption 1).** Where an issue's text becomes `fields[].message` is `zodIssuesToFields` in `packages/spec/src/api/`, not a `packages/types` / `packages/rest` mapper: types' `fieldsFromZodIssues` and rest's `crud-routes` both call it. Carrying the hint there covers both measured doors with one edit, so the diff touches `zod-issues-to-fields.ts` and `api/index.ts` (exports `refusalHeadOf`, `REFUSAL_HEAD_MAX` for `@objectstack/types`) and adds `shared/refusal-head.ts`. Because the mapper is shared, the analytics selection door (`POST /analytics/…`, `runtimeFilter` comparands) answers the same head and hint for the same refusals.

**The engine's `find('…'):` prefix.** It leads the head when the two fit in 160 characters and is left out when they do not (a long object name); the hint keeps it either way. A field name in a head is elided past 40 characters, so the longest comparand head (the `$between` arm with a `$field` endpoint) is 153 characters whatever the caller sent. A head that somehow broke the bound would be dropped, never thrown, so a refusal can never turn into a fault.

### Readers census (the order's assumption 2)

- `packages/client` and `ui/**` hold no fixture pinning the full text in `fields[].message` or `error` (grep of every listed prescription). No change there; ⛔ no `ui/**` change.
- Four rest pins read the face's or the tombstone's sentence from `fields[].message`; each now reads it from `hint`, meaning kept (the sentence is still the face's / the tombstone's, not a generic one): `aggregation-entry-undeclared-key-door.test.ts`, `analytics-filter-refusal-envelope.test.ts`, `data-boolean-comparand-door.test.ts`, `data-number-comparand-door.test.ts`.
- No spec pin changed. Every spec substring pin stays green because the prescriptions are byte-equal.

### Follow-ups, not in this diff (other long spec refusals)

- `query.windowFunctions` tombstone (454 characters) and `FIELD_NODE_OBJECT_FORM_REMOVED`, the object-form `fields` entry (1,056), both in `query.zod.ts`.
- The comparand-TYPE face (`filter-comparand-type.ts`): a plain object, `Map` or out-of-range bigint comparand (`GET ?filter=` object comparand, 404). The CONTROL pin keeps it unheaded here.
- `FieldOperatorsSchema` operator-slot sentences where a filter is judged outside the save-door walk (`filter.zod.ts`).
- The engine's option refusal `find('x') does not recognise option 'cursor': …` embeds `QUERY_CURSOR_REMOVED` inside its own sentence (`objectql/src/engine-top-level.ts`), so it is not headed.

## Pins and ablations

- `packages/spec/src/shared/refusal-head.test.ts` (15): each listed query refusal maps to `message` ≤ 160 naming the key and `hint` = the issue's own message, with the field code pinned; CONTROL: `formatZodIssue` (what `os compile` renders) prints the prescription byte for byte and the parse message equals `QUERY_CURSOR_REMOVED` / `QUERY_DISTINCT_REMOVED`; CONTROL: an unheaded issue maps with no `hint` member; the save door keeps the prescription and carries `params.refusalHead`; every face arm's head ≤ 160 at a 200-character field, eleven distinct heads; the context rule; the head contract; `FieldErrorSchema` parses with and without `hint`.
- `packages/types/src/refusal-head-answer.test.ts` (5): `mapDataError` answers head + `details.hint` with status and code unchanged; the passthrough wrapper merges `details`; CONTROL: no head, no change; CONTROL: a 5xx is left alone; `fieldsFromZodIssues` carries `hint`.
- `packages/rest/src/data-refusal-head-hint-door.test.ts` (15, real routes, real `SqlDriver`, engine and protocol): the eight listed `POST /query` refusals (status, code, field, field code, head ≤ 160 naming the key, hint carrying the prescription at its measured length, no read); the hint equals `QUERY_CURSOR_REMOVED` / `QUERY_DISTINCT_REMOVED`; four `GET ?filter=` refusals (`error` ≤ 160, led by `find('…'):`, `details.hint` with the located prescription, no read); CONTROLs: `windowFunctions` keeps its whole sentence and no hint, the comparand-type face answers as before with no `details`.

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

- (a) hint mapping removed (`...(head === undefined ? {} : { hint: message })` → nothing) in `zodIssuesToFields`: `refusal-head.test.ts` 7 failed, e.g. `AssertionError: expected undefined to be '<the array_agg prescription>'` for each of the six query refusals, and the flag arm's hint read.
- (b) head swapped back to the full text (`message: head ?? message` → `message: message`): 7 failed, `AssertionError: expected 1021 to be less than or equal to 160` (and 1249, 1078, 763, 623, 644).
- (c) the thrown-error head read removed in `withRefusalHeadAnswer`: `refusal-head-answer.test.ts` 2 failed, `error` stayed the whole `find('deal'): Operator "$in" …` sentence where the head was expected.

## Verification

All local, on the branch after merging `origin/main` (bbcf46e2) and regenerating; exit codes captured before any pipe.

- Full build: `os-verify-lock.sh -c "npx turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=3"`: exit 0 (11m14s).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 111 families; all 111 ran, every exit 0 (`--ran`: 111 derived, 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). One red on the first pass, fixed: `pnpm check:test-source-alias` asked `analytics-filter-refusal-envelope.test.ts` (edited here) to pay the `@objectstack/objectql` load at collection; added the module-top import, re-ran: exit 0.
- Suites: `@objectstack/spec` 926 files / 28,167 tests (the one red was `export-origins` before regeneration; re-ran green), `@objectstack/types` 39 / 886, `@objectstack/rest` 406 files (4 reader pins in 3 files red before the census edits; those files re-ran green, 43 passed / 18 skipped, plus the new file 15/15 and `aggregation-entry-undeclared-key-door`). Downstream readers of the mapper, full suites: `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-analytics`, `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: each exit 0. `@objectstack/mcp` `mcp-http-tools.aggregation-entry.test.ts` (relays the tombstone sentence): exit 0, unaffected.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/{spec,types,rest} run typecheck`: exit 0 each.
- `pnpm lint` on the 16 touched `.ts` files (`eslint … --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated --fix`: regenerated `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `authorable-surface` (`api/FieldError:hint`) and the `errors` / `push-relay` references; re-check green.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (The head helper is a declaration-time table and a pure reader beside `zodIssuesToFields`.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The `维护者速读` block is the dispatch order's required Chinese summary.)
